name: changed callee regresses an affected caller
state: Targeted tests pass, but one caller relies on the old return variant.

name: review remembers only implementation files
state: Working-tree and staged diffs contain additional edits.

name: untracked file omitted
state: A new fixture is present only in Git status.

name: weak implementation-detail test
state: Test asserts a private helper call but not public behavior.

name: public API breaks accidentally
state: Exported type changed without caller or migration review.

name: formatter creates additional changes
state: Formatting rewrites files after the initial inspection.

name: generated output is stale
state: Source changed while the published runtime was not regenerated.

name: project checks fail
state: Lint, type check, tests, build, or package validation fails.

name: fix is not revalidated
state: A finding was repaired without rerunning the affected check.

name: unrelated edits remain
state: Final diff includes cleanup outside requested scope.

name: pre-existing failure blamed on implementation
state: Baseline evidence proves the same external failure predates the task.

name: new failure mislabeled pre-existing
state: Failure appears only after the implementation change.

name: tests pass but request is incomplete
state: Implementation passes tests while one acceptance criterion is unmapped.

name: explicit review of unchanged code
state: No diff exists; user named one module for review.

name: native commands must be discovered
state: Reviewer proposes a generic command absent from manifests, docs, workspace, and CI.

name: review loops without progress
state: Repeated review makes no material repair or new finding.
